svg.title: Untitled
svg.desc: Hand-authored interpretive SVG after direct visual inspection of the cited primary reference. Approximate contours and standardized vivid colors; paint texture, photographic perspective and external framing omitted. Painted white cutout-like form is on cream paper; paper and form share white recolor family with distinct default shades. Pencil contour and aging omitted.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://matthewmarks.com/exhibitions/ellsworth-kelly-drawings-1954-1962-02-2009/lightbox/works/untitled-1959-31172; record matthewmarks-untitled-1959-31172; visual review 2026-10-27. Pure-vector study; not a facsimile.
